summary: @servicetitan/measure-sheet-data preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated bundle
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs fetches the Bun runtime binary from github.com/oven-sh/bun releases (v1.3.13), writes it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and invokes it against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727KB Bun-compiled bundle with a @bun-cjs header, a WV8StW() string-array-rotation decoder, a large mixed integer/string constant array, and char-code reconstruction routines; identifiers are obfuscator-shaped (MmgoCP, etDiOOB, _0x...) and the file contains no readable strings related to the package's advertised purpose. The package is documented as a static React data store for glass measurement shapes, so pulling down a second language runtime at install time to execute an obfuscated compiled bundle is not consistent with its declared scope. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to execute on the installer's host under the freshly-downloaded Bun binary before any application code runs.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
